name: Love The Lord
overview: Scripture commands believers to love the Lord their God with all their heart, soul, and mind, emphasizing complete devotion and singular loyalty as Jesus teaches in Matthew 22:37. This total love for God is incompatible with divided allegiances, as Matthew 6:24 warns that no one can serve two masters without despising one. Furthermore, loving God wholeheartedly naturally extends into loving others, with Mark 12:31 highlighting that loving one's neighbor is inseparable from the greatest commandments.
